dashboard.title: Admin Dashboard
dashboard.lead: System overview and quick access to management sections. Statistics are fetched from live platform services.

errors.allDown: None of the dashboard services were available.

membershipConfig.title: Membership Settings
membershipConfig.lead: Member discounts, directory visibility, areas of expertise, sales plans, and change log.
membershipConfig.helpBody: "Money" (member discounts, limits, coupon policy, grace period) can only be saved with the Financial Manager role. "Program" (directory visibility, expertise areas) only with the Membership Manager role. "Plans" with either of those two roles. "Reset to Default" resets the entire section, not just a single field. "History" currently displays the raw ID of the actor; displaying the name is deferred to the next step.

money.readOnly: Only the finance manager can save or reset this section.
money.percentHelper: 0 to 100 — zero means discount is off.
money.maxRialLabel: Maximum discount cap (leave blank for unlimited)
money.categoriesHelper: Applies only when the scope is "Selected categories".
money.stackingHelper: "Best discount/coupon": applies whichever gives the higher discount. "Coupon wins": if a coupon is present, the membership discount is ignored. "Stack both": both discounts are applied together.
money.errSave: Failed to save the financial section.
money.errReset: Failed to reset the financial section.
money.errPercentRange: Must be an integer between 0 and 100.
money.errMaxRial: Must be a non-negative integer (or blank for unlimited).
money.errGraceRange: Must be an integer between 0 and 365.
money.errCategoriesRequired: At least one category is required when the scope is "Selected categories".

resetConfirm.title: Reset "Money" section to defaults
resetConfirm.body: The member discount, maximum cap, scope, coupon policy, and grace period will all return to system defaults — not just a single field. This takes effect immediately and is logged in the history; you can save custom values again if needed.

program.readOnly: Only the membership manager can save or reset this section.
program.publicNote: Currently acts equivalent to "Authenticated users"; unauthenticated display coming in the next wave
program.note: Adding/removing/editing domains in this step is not supported — existing domains can only be toggled on/off.
program.errSave: Failed to save the program section.
program.errReset: Failed to reset the program section.
program.errNoActive: At least one active specialty domain is required.

plans.readOnly: Only membership managers or financial managers can create or edit plans.
plans.activeLabel: Active (an active plan must have a price greater than zero)
plans.errCode: Invalid plan code — only lowercase English letters, numbers, and underscores are allowed.
plans.errNameFa: The Persian name of the plan is required.
plans.errPrice: The price must be a non-negative integer.
plans.errPeriod: The period must be an integer of at least 1.
plans.confirmBody: The plan "{name}" will be deactivated and will no longer be available for purchase. This action will be recorded in the history.

history.empty: No events have been recorded yet.

readOnly.title: Your access on this page is read-only
readOnly.body: Creating and revoking parent links is an access-granting decision: from that moment on, the parent can view the student's grades, attendance, tuition, and health summary. This decision belongs to the admin; you can view and search active links.
readOnly.empty: No links have been recorded yet.

status.title: Rule Enforcement Status
status.allOn: All applicable rules on this page are enabled and enforced by the server.
status.offIntro: These rules are configured but are not currently enforced — the numbers next to them are for display only:
status.hint: To enforce them, turn on the respective rule's toggle in its group and click "Save Regulations".

objectionWindowMinDays.label: Minimum Student Objection Window (Days)
objectionWindowMinDays.helper: Instructors cannot set a shorter window than this when submitting grades. 0 means no minimum.

minCreditFloorEnforced.label: Enforce Minimum Credit Floor When Dropping Courses
minCreditFloorEnforced.helper: Enabled (default) = Drops that bring semester credits below the floor are rejected; probation, summer, and final semesters are exempt. Disabled = Display warning only.

attendanceMaxAbsenceRatio.label: Maximum Unexcused Absence Ratio
attendanceMaxAbsenceRatio.helper: 3/16 ≈ 0.1875 — Exceeding this ratio flags the student as "subject to a zero grade"

lateGraceMinutes.label: Late Arrival Grace Period (Minutes)
lateGraceMinutes.helper: Arrival up to this many minutes after start = present, after that = late

closeGraceMinutes.label: Automatic Session Closure Grace Period (Minutes)
closeGraceMinutes.helper: An open session past its scheduled end will automatically close after this many minutes

openGraceMinutes.label: Automatic Class Opening Grace Period (Minutes)
openGraceMinutes.helper: The classroom is ready for entry this many minutes before the scheduled start

noShowGraceMinutes.label: Instructor Absence Warning Grace Period (Minutes)
noShowGraceMinutes.helper: If the instructor does not join within this period after the scheduled start, the faculty officer is warned; the class is not automatically canceled

supervisionGraceSeconds.label: Educational Supervisor Absence Grace Period (Seconds)
supervisionGraceSeconds.helper: Following a continuous absence of an authorized supervisor, recording pauses and the academic director is notified; default is 120 seconds

passThresholdPercent.label: Passing Threshold (Percent)
passThresholdPercent.helper: The percentage that aligns exactly with the passing grade of the program level

summerCapMax.label: Summer Semester Credit Cap
summerCapMax.helper: "Summer maximum 6 credits" — enforced only with the toggle below

summerCapEnforced.label: Enforce Summer Cap
summerCapEnforced.helper: Off (default) = normal summer cap; On = high cap applies (regardless of GPA)

emergencyDropWindowEnforced.label: Enforce emergency drop window
emergencyDropWindowEnforced.helper: On = emergency drop is only permitted within the EMERGENCY_DROP interval

gradeEntryWindowEnforced.label: Enforce grade entry window
gradeEntryWindowEnforced.helper: On = grade submission/finalization is only permitted within the GRADE_ENTRY interval

help.title: Regulation Guide
help.body: These values determine organization-level ministerial rules (attendance, grading, course enrollment, objections, windows). Each has a ministerial default; edit and save to customize for this organization. The "Customized" badge indicates a value differs from the ministerial default.

enrollment.title: Course Enrollment and Add/Drop
enrollment.note: The summer cap only applies when the "Enforce summer cap" toggle is on. It is off by default, meaning summer uses the normal cap.

calendar.title: Calendar Windows
calendar.note: Both off by default = today's behavior (no interval restriction).

errors.formInvalid: Some values are invalid; please correct the red fields.

help.title: Treasury Guide
help.body: General ledger overview (Asset/Liability/Income/Expense), treasury settlement of payroll runs (net payment + deduction deposit from cash account), and payroll cost report with CSV export. Settlement zeros out the "Payable Salaries/Deductions" accounts against "Cash".

recon.title: Financial Health & Wallet Reconciliation
recon.desc: Read-only check of monetary invariants; every value should be zero. Discrepancies indicate the ledger requires review (this check does not modify anything).
recon.unbackedNote: This counter shows settled rows that lack a double-entry document — almost always a legacy of pre-atomic-correction payments. A non-zero number is not an error and does not turn the 'Healthy' status red; remediation is done at the CFO's discretion via script execution.

roster.title: Students / Financial Status
roster.desc: Search the list of students with tuition invoices by name or student ID. Click any row to open the complete financial file (invoices, installments, payments, loans, scholarships, refunds). Only financial data is displayed.
roster.searchAria: Search student by name or ID
roster.empty: No student with an invoice found matching this filter.

receivables.title: Tuition Receivables Report
receivables.noBills: No tuition bills have been recorded.

payables.title: Payroll Settlement
payables.empty: There are no paid payroll runs to settle.
payables.noticeWallet: Settlement completed: Net salary was deposited into the staff wallets and deductions were paid from the treasury (Total {amount}).
payables.noticeCash: Settlement completed: {amount} was paid from the treasury.

report.title: Payroll Cost Report
report.empty: No issued slips have been recorded.

users.title: Users
users.helpBody: On this page, you can create user accounts, assign roles, and reset passwords if needed. Click "+ Add User" to create a new account or "Bulk Import (CSV)" to import multiple users at once; click any user's row to edit their details. The "Dossier" provides a complete view of each individual: for students, it includes academic transcripts, quizzes, assignments, attendance, and activity; for instructors, it displays classes, teaching load, and grading progress.

form.emailLockedHelper: Email cannot be changed after creation.
form.initialPasswordHelper: At least 8 characters. The user can change it later from their profile.
form.roleLocked: Only the Super Admin can assign this role
form.rolesHelper: Administrative roles (System Admin / Super Admin) can only be assigned by the Super Admin.
form.facultyHelper: The dean of faculty manages only this faculty. Takes effect upon the user's next login after saving.
form.newPasswordHelper: At least 8 characters. All active sessions for this user will be invalidated.

bulk.title: Bulk User Import (CSV)
bulk.intro:
Select a CSV file with the headers email,fullName,roles,password. The email and fullName columns are required; roles (separated by

|

) and password are optional. If the password is left blank, the system will generate a random password and display it only in this page's report.
bulk.badHeader: The first row must be a header and contain at least the email and fullName columns (download the sample file).
bulk.noRows: No data found after the header row.
bulk.readFailed: Failed to read the file. Please select a valid CSV file.
bulk.warning: ⚠️ Generated passwords are shown only here and cannot be recovered later; please download the report before closing.
bulk.noReport: No report received from the server.

membershipQueue.title: Membership Queue

help.title: Help
help.body: "Verify identity" moves a pending membership to verified; the user then pays from their "My Membership" page. "Suspend", "Unsuspend", and "Revoke" are only available with the Membership Manager role. Revocation is final and irreversible; the row is not deleted, its status only changes to "Revoked" and it remains in the history for transparency. When a membership with a field of expertise is activated, the user is automatically added to the corresponding specialty group in the messenger.

actions.revokeConfirm: Revocation is irreversible — are you sure?

empty.title: No memberships in this status
empty.body: The list is filtered by the selected status. Clear the filter to view all requests.

membershipQueue.selectHint: Select a membership from the list.
